description: Defines structures and functions for configuring and managing CSI (Channel State Information) parameters in a 5G NR context, including CSI-RS resource periodicity, slot offsets, and measurement configuration.

classes.name: du_csi_params
classes.description: Holds configurable CSI parameters for a DU cell, including symbol indices, resource periodicity, slot offsets, and report settings.

classes.name: csi_meas_config_builder_params
classes.description: Extends du_csi_params with cell-specific parameters such as PCI, RBs, ports, MCS table, and max layers for CSI measurement configuration.

methods.name: get_max_csi_rs_period
methods.description: Computes the default CSI-RS signalling period based on TS38.214 constraints.

methods.name: is_csi_rs_period_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given CSI-RS period is valid for a specific TDD configuration.

methods.name: find_valid_csi_rs_period
methods.description: Finds a valid CSI-RS period that conforms to TDD pattern constraints.

methods.name: derive_valid_csi_rs_slot_offsets
methods.description: Determines valid slot offsets for measurement, tracking, and interference management CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_periodic_zp_csi_rs_resource_list
methods.description: Generates a list of periodic zero-CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_periodic_zp_csi_rs_resource_set
methods.description: Creates a set of periodic zero-CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_nzp_csi_rs_resource_list
methods.description: Generates a list of wideband NZP-CSI-RS resources for tracking and measurements.

methods.name: make_csi_meas_config
methods.description: Constructs a CSI measurement configuration based on provided parameters and resource list.
